full_page.content:
1947, April 18
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
(POST CARD)
Mrs. Alice Plunkett 11 Moss Ave. Highland Park 3, Michigan
Blessed be God in all His works! April 18th 1947.
God bless you Grandma Plunkett -- yourself and your many friends.
- Many thanks for your charitable favor of several week past duely received and noted. Please pardon my so long delayed acknowledgement. Keep well and pray for the conversion of the rest of us -- poor sinners as we all are. Sincerely yours in Christ,
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Original in possession of : Miss Esther Plunkett 20505 Charleston Detroit, Michigan 48203
